name: Verifone eCommerce for WooCommerce
author: Verifone Finland

sections.description:
Verifone eCommerce is a domestic online payment service built on Verifone’s strong expertise in payment solutions. Designed for businesses of all sizes from small online shops to large retail chains it allows you to manage both online and in-store payments within a single system.

With Verifone’s online payment service you can offer card payments, mobile wallets, and invoice & installment options to Finnish consumers and businesses under a single agreement. We continuously develop the service and ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions.

Wide Range of Payment Methods:

  • Bank Payments – The most commonly used bank payment options, including Nordea, OP, Danske Bank, S-Pankki, Aktia, Oma Säästöpankki, and many others. A full list is available on our website.
  • Card Payments – Visa, MasterCard, Eurocard (AirPlus), American Express, Diners Club, and PayPal.
  • Mobile Payments – MobilePay, Apple Pay and Siirto.
  • Invoice & Installment Options – OP Invoice.

Key Features:

  • Reliability & Performance – Trusted by businesses that rely on high operational stability.
  • Fastest Settlement Time on the Market – Funds are transferred quickly and transparently to your account.
  • Mobile-Optimized Payment Pages – Fully functional on all mobile devices, helping improve conversions and reduce abandoned carts.
  • Local Customer Support – Fast and professional assistance via phone and email.
  • Easy Setup – Quick installation through the WooCommerce plugin for smooth onboarding.
  • Reporting & Monitoring – Access a dedicated reporting tool that provides a clear overview of your payment flows across both online and physical sales channels.
  • Security – Verifone is a financial institution supervised by the Financial Supervisory Authority, and all payment services comply with PCI requirements.
  • Unified Payment Management – Seamless coordination of in-store and online payments from one platform.

To use the service, you’ll need an active Verifone eCommerce agreement. If you don’t have one yet, our website provides contact details and a request form to help you get started.

For the payment gateway to function, order and customer details are transmitted to Verifone’s servers when the Verifone eCommerce payment method is used at checkout. You can find more information about our data handling practices on our website.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Verifone eCommerce for WooCommerce” or click Upload Plugin to upload the ZIP file.
  3. Click Install Now, then activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  5. Enable “Verifone eCommerce” and click Manage to configure the settings.
